title: Affinity-scored intake + deprecation safety-net for enterprise model onboarding
creator: Priya Patel
description: Problem: Enterprise customers frequently request version pinning, exceptions, and slow deprecations for models used in regulated or revenue-critical flows. Current intake treats these as ad-hoc tickets which creates churn for runtime and routing engineers and leads to customer-impacting surprises during catalog pruning. Goal: Design an affinity-scored intake + automated safety-net that racks customer requests by impact, suggests a migration playbook, and enforces soft deprecation gates (shadow trial, rollout ramp, rollback hooks) before hard removals. Scope: intake rubric changes in PM flow, add affinity scoring signal (SLA, usage, data-sensitivity, pinned routes), UI affordances in the Console model page to request pins/quarantine, and runtime flags + policy enforcement for staged deprecations. Out of scope: full multitenant KMS integrations and new billing model changes. Success metrics: reduce manual engineering triage time for enterprise pin/deprecation requests by 50% within first quarter after launch; decrease high-severity customer incidents from deprecation by 90% during sunset windows; 80% of new model onboarding requests receive an automated recommended gating plan within 48 hours.
acceptance_criteria: Affinity scoring algorithm defined and documented in Confluence with weighting matrix for SLA, daily traffic, pinned routes, and data-sensitivity
Console: new "Request Pin/Quarantine" CTA on model detail that pre-fills recommended gating plan
Intake pipeline returns a recommended plan (shadow trial duration, canary %, rollback criteria) within 48 hours for 80% of enterprise requests
Runtime: enforcement layer supports soft deprecation flags routed per-tenant and per-route with automatic fallback to previous model for failures
Playbook: migration advisory artifacts generated automatically and attached to the ticket and emailed to requestor
comments: 2025-02-14 — PM kickoff with Eng and Design. Agreed to prioritize per-tenant pinning over global freezes to reduce blast radius. (Avery Chan, Diego Morales, Elena Rossi)
2025-02-20 — Engineering feasibility review: implementing per-route routing policy requires extension to smart routing table and additional policy cache. Estimated +3 backend sprints. (Samir Gupta)

2025-02-28 — Decision: start with default shadow trial of 7 days and canary ramp schedule 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% unless rollback criteria met. Safety-net requires an automated regression check using existing eval harness. (Priya Patel)
